name: lockray
description: X-ray your lockfile diffs: catch lockfile injection, tampered packages, install scripts and typosquats before they merge.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.mjs --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __lockrayCreateRequire } from "node:module"; const require = __lockrayCreateRequire(import.meta.url);'
